title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Payments and Waivers Credited on the Account
content:
## Clause

The credit side of a Dangerous Goods Acceptance account, as used when a covering remittance is applied, is made up of two kinds of entry taken across the acceptance's whole life: every payment already applied, and every goodwill waiver granted. Each is counted at the amount shown on its entry.

## Illustration (invented amounts)

| Credit entry | Amount |
|---|---|
| Payment applied last month | 500.00 |
| Goodwill waiver of an amendment fee | 130.00 |
| Credit side in total | 630.00 |

## Points of judgement

**Does a payment on another acceptance count here?** No; only entries on this acceptance's own account are taken.

**A waiver was granted on a fee that had been booked a year earlier. Is it still a credit?** Yes; the whole life of the acceptance is taken.
